voice.text: Night. A topic. The video is due by morning.

beats.what: Dark. Editor UI fades up on the desk. Tiny clay cube in the composition window wakes, blinks, looks around.
Cube jumps from the composition onto the timeline, squash on landing, glowing playhead line, camera follows.
Cube runs along the coloured tracks; clips bounce under its feet; stops and looks at the empty composition.
A 'topic' field appears in the composition; cube pokes it; 'How prediction markets work' types in.
Cube hops back into the composition; 6 storyboard cards fly in and line up.
Cards turn into live scenes (doodle / cartoon); cube watches and nods.
Cube runs on along the timeline; coloured scene blocks drop onto the tracks as it hops from one to the next.
Voice waveform in the composition pulses; cube listens and sways.
Music track appears below; beat markers pulse; cube jumps on the beat.
Fast cuts of finished frames in different looks; 16:9 and 9:16; EN / RU; cube blinks approvingly.
Cube sits on the timeline edge; 'tvhead-studio' title in the composition; cube looks at the viewer.
Camera pulls back; 'MADE WITH CLAUDE' appears; cube sits in the bottom-right corner of the composition.
Final frame: cube blinks and hops; GitHub line appears; music fades.
